title: Reading lab: John 15:9–17
subtitle: Follow repeated commands, conditions, and purpose.
overview: This paragraph is structured by repeated μένω, ἀγάπη, ἐντολή, and ἵνα. Repetition creates the connective tissue of the discourse.
Read each imperative and condition in relation to the preceding claim; do not make the paragraph a list of detached commands.

items.grc: ἐὰν τὰς ἐντολάς μου τηρήσητε, μενεῖτε ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ μου.
items.en: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love.

items.grc: ταῦτα ἐντέλλομαι ὑμῖν, ἵνα ἀγαπᾶτε ἀλλήλους.
items.en: These things I command you, so that you may love one another.
